items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: my recording contract was with Senator Jones. ... I'm the writer on one side.

ctx.x: Yeah. I did this with C-Saint. Sometime you get it and sometime you don't. And what happened, we had a thing going when the station over right over there. Clyde L. Yeah. Well, whatever station was, we had it. We had it going pretty good. And they put this on. They put the on program. And one of the big black DJs. Oh. Well, he was on vacation and the little dude put the record on for me who was in his place. Yeah. And was doing fine. Fixed and catch. So, Senator Jones kept there and said, man, I bet you, and I…
